name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: A sharp cut, but $398 is still above Thursday's $364.36 close, and it's the low one in your table: JPM and BofA both reiterated Buy on 11/9. The split among analysts matters more than any single target. Dec 9 earnings are the next checkpoint for the financing question.

TSMC putting $500M behind chip startups, and maybe suppliers for the first time, is the supply chain betting on itself. The next Broadcom gets built, not bought. Worth watching who the fund actually backs. $AVGO

The re-rating case is really about the mix: custom silicon plus the networking that ties it together. $16.7B in AI semis, up 221%, is the number that has to keep compounding. December 9 is when margins get checked. $AVGO

The Broadcom angle is the interesting part here. A scaled MRVL-LITE gives Nvidia a counterweight without owning the fabs, but Cisco and Arista won't love a captive stack, and SAMR gets 18-24 months to weigh in.
收 364.36，四连涨，五个交易日涨了快 12%。50 日线 345.59 踩在脚下了，上面就是 200 日线 367.34。量也放出来了，RSI 59.5，还没到过热。接下来就看 200 日线能不能站住，12 月 9 号财报是下一关。$AVGO

Glass substrate is moving from roadmap to purchase orders. Samsung Electro-Mechanics targeting pilot production in 2027 and mass production in 2028 — if that holds, it's a real timeline for large AI packages, and Broadcom is the obvious customer to watch.

Agree. The deterministic architecture point is the key one, and Broadcom's custom work with OpenAI and Anthropic is where that shift shows up first. The question is how fast customers move off GPU programmability, given how sticky that ecosystem is.
英伟达风波不断，资金这几天往定制芯片这边挪。AVGO 三连涨 17.6%，昨天收 345.22，离 50 日线 345.64 只差 0.42，盘后又到了 357 附近。先当超跌修复看，12 月 9 号财报才是下一关。$AVGO

Fair point on open standards. If the SC26 demos turn into design wins, networking becomes a steadier leg next to custom silicon. AVGO closed at $331.98, still below its 50-day average of $346.13, so this needs follow through, not just a good show.

Morgan Stanley still puts 72% upside on Broadcom in the middle of the AI-infra selloff, above even the Street's ~$530 average target. The distance from $332 says a lot about how fast sentiment turned, less about the order book. $AVGO
Burry 又盯上博通了。据 @burrytracker 转述，他翻 Anthropic 交易发现博通承诺供 1610 亿美元设备、还另有 420 亿美元“出借”，质疑这是拿越做越大的交易藏债务，表态不买下周的 IPO。另一边也有反驳：博通是成本加成、严格预收现金，不是供应商融资。这笔账 12 月 9 日财报前大概还得吵一阵。$AVGO
